# CSV to JSON

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/csv-to-json/

Parse CSV with quoted fields, escaped quotes and line breaks inside cells. Use the first row as property names and export a JSON array.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Convert a spreadsheet export with name and country columns into sample JSON records.

## Limits and checks

Column headers must be unique and each row must have the same number of fields. Values remain text rather than inferred dates or numbers.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
